learned: 2026-10-17: levelexperience.com/test-results-states/new-york/ lists ~37 NY report PDFs (accordion of links; /page/2/ repeats page 1). The media library reports 1,190 PDFs but the REST endpoint returns an empty list, so wp_media does not work. CA and PA have their own pages.
notes: Filenames are NYPT<YYMMDD><code>.pdf: d9H Hybrid, d9S Sativa, d9I Indica, LO Lights Out, bst Boost, RCVR Recover (Protab); ENERGY / SLUMBER (Level 5); d9IMAX / d9SMAX (Protab Max).
The lot is the filename stem; the strain comes from the report's product line or the code (strain_code).

strain_code resolves d9H/d9I/d9S (Hybrid/Indica/Sativa; S is ambiguous with Slumber unless the report's product line 'LEVEL Sativa Protab' decides). LO, bst and RCVR codes do not begin their strain's name (Lights Out, Boost, Recover); those rely on the report's product line ('LEVEL Lights Out Protab +').
